Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott

Record Class OttGenerationParameters

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.ott.OttGenerationParameters
Record Components:
channel - channel the token is delivered through.
kind - whether the token is a numeric code or a magic link.
purpose - whether the token signs the user in or is a second factor of a signed-in user.
public record OttGenerationParameters(OttChannel channel, OttKind kind, OttPurpose purpose) extends Record
What a request to POST /ott/generate asks for, read from its form fields: through which channel, a numeric code or a magic link, and for a sign-in or as a second factor. Every unknown or missing value falls back to the default (an e-mail code for a sign-in), so a malformed request is answered like any other.

  • Method Details

    • from

      public static OttGenerationParameters from(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication current)
      Reads the parameters of a request. A magic link is only sent by e-mail, so an SMS request is always a code, and a second factor is only possible for a user who is signed in: for anybody else the request is a sign-in.
      Parameters:
      request - the request.
      current - the authentication of the request, or null.
      Returns:
      the parameters.
